inputs.name: servers
inputs.description: Server nodes, by name: a map of names to addresses, or to host objects with an address and optional host_key, user, port, private_key_file, jump_hosts or advertise. Give an odd number.

inputs.name: clients
inputs.description: Client nodes, which run your jobs, by name, in the same form as servers. A name can't be both a server and a client.

inputs.name: gossip_key
inputs.description: Key that encrypts the servers' gossip traffic: 32 bytes in base64, from nomad operator gossip keyring generate or openssl rand -base64 32. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_gossip_key; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: join_addresses
inputs.description: Addresses nodes use to find the servers. When null, each server's advertise address, or else its address. Set it when Conn3x reaches the servers on a different address from the one the nodes use.

inputs.name: acl_enabled
inputs.description: Turn on Nomad's ACLs. Until you run nomad acl bootstrap, nobody can do anything through the API. Without ACLs, anyone who reaches port 4646 can run jobs on your clients.

inputs.name: server_config
inputs.description: More agent settings for the servers, written to /etc/nomad.d/50-extra.json, such as { tls = { http = true, rpc = true } }. Nomad merges this over the circuit's own settings.

inputs.name: client_config
inputs.description: More agent settings for the clients, written to /etc/nomad.d/50-extra.json, such as { client = { node_pool = "gpu" } }. Nomad merges this over the circuit's own settings.

inputs.name: nomad_version
inputs.description: Nomad release to install, without the v. Change it together with checksums.

inputs.name: checksums
inputs.description: SHA-256 of the Nomad zip for each architecture, from the release's SHA256SUMS file. Change these with nomad_version.
